name: pokemon-tcg
description: Pokémon TCG under the Simplified-Chinese official rules (CN/V20261019): a reviewed rules kernel, real CN card printings and a web game against the CPU.

scripts.rules:build: npm run rules:schema && npm run rules:kernel
scripts.test: npm run test:rules:official && npm run test:cn-cards && npm run test:cn-card-review && npm run test:cn-merged && npm run test:cn-table && npm run test:match-records && npm run test:accounts && npm run test:effect-corpus && npm run test:release-transport && npm run test:ai && npm run test:engine-host
scripts.test:rules:official: npm run rules:schema:check && npm run rules:kernel:check && node --import ./tests/verify-reads.mjs --test tests/official-rules/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:rules:official:coverage: npm run rules:schema:check && npm run rules:kernel:check && node --import ./tests/verify-reads.mjs --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='public/rules/**/*.js' --test-coverage-exclude='public/rules/schema-validators.js' --test-coverage-exclude='public/rules/kernel-build.js' --test-coverage-lines=100 --test-coverage-functions=100 --test-coverage-branches=95 --test tests/official-rules/*.test.mjs
scripts.start: npm run web:build && npm run serve
scripts.web:build: npm run rules:schema:check && npm run rules:kernel:check && npm run cn:release:check && node scripts/build-web.mjs
scripts.web:publish: npm run web:build && sf publish site --space spc_d541c63539a747a985a7ee39408f4087
